scratchpad_checklist: Search web or local documentation for relevant material using KnowledgeModule web_search
Store key verified findings into long-term knowledge memory using KnowledgeModule store_fact
Write comprehensive final research report to research_report.md (with markdown headers and citations like [1]) using WorkspaceModule create_file

post_llm_validation_hook.on_failure_instruction: Research deliverable verification failed. Ensure you have recorded verified facts with KnowledgeModule.store_fact and written a comprehensive markdown report (at least 350 characters, with markdown headers and citations like [1] or [Author, Year]) to research_report.md before completing.
